summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands-on embedded Systems on Chip experience across ARM Cortex architecture microcontrollers, writing bare-metal firmware in the C programming language and using software debugging tools to view and program processor registers. Built and documented real-time firmware and device drivers for sensor-driven control systems, producing technical writing and documentation throughout. Comfortable across the full board bring-up cycle: PCB reference design, device drivers, and hardware/software integration testing.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition device integrating an ADXL345 accelerometer and HC-05 Bluetooth device driver with a Raspberry Pi, translating 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and register-level resolution tuning.
Produced full technical documentation and a bill of materials for a Mixed Reality headset concept using AI-based real-time chroma keying.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCB reference designs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback during board bring-up.
Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and embedded systems integration end-to-end.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed ARM Cortex-M4 peripherals directly via processor registers in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate, verified with an oscilloscope for register-level debugging.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C device driver for real-time temperature sensing and display.

projects.name: Frame Simulator — Desktop 3D Coordinate-Frame Visualizer
bullets: Built a PySide6/Qt desktop GUI with an OpenGL-backed 3D viewport to visualize coordinate-frame hierarchies, parent-child transform chains, and SE(3) poses in real time.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Deployed a Jetson-based embedded Linux service as a systemd unit (auto-restart with backoff, non-root user/group isolation, environment-file-based config) with static IP networking for reliable device registration.
Configured XRDP remote desktop administration for headless Linux system management.

awards: 1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
